nodes.label: Obsidian + AI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Obsidian plus AI is used to improve decision-making, documentation, and feature planning.

nodes.label: Tech Stack: Laravel, React + Vite, Docker, MySQL, Redis, Reverb
nodes.norm_label: tech stack: laravel, react + vite, docker, mysql, redis, reverb

nodes.label: Independent Projects Each Owning Their Docker Setup
nodes.rationale: The platform is split into independent projects (backend, frontend-admin, frontend-customer); each owns its Docker setup so it can be built and run separately.
nodes.norm_label: independent projects each owning their docker setup

nodes.label: Backend (Laravel API, DB, Redis, Worker, Reverb, Nginx)
nodes.norm_label: backend (laravel api, db, redis, worker, reverb, nginx)

nodes.label: CONTAINER_ROLE Entrypoint Role Selection
nodes.rationale: Queue worker and scheduler reuse the same image; docker-entrypoint.sh selects behaviour via the CONTAINER_ROLE variable.

nodes.label: Default Admin Credentials Seeded When APP_ENV=local
nodes.norm_label: default admin credentials seeded when app_env=local

nodes.label: Production Deployment (static frontends, Nginx on port 80)
nodes.rationale: Production builds optimized static frontends and runs the queue worker; backend exposes port 80 via its own Nginx container.
nodes.norm_label: production deployment (static frontends, nginx on port 80)

nodes.label: Backend Endpoint Test Results (70 tests, 231 assertions)
nodes.norm_label: backend endpoint test results (70 tests, 231 assertions)

nodes.label: SQLite In-Memory Test Database
nodes.rationale: phpunit.xml uses SQLite :memory: by default so `php artisan test` runs without Docker; phpunit.host.xml remains for a file-based SQLite DB.

nodes.label: Customer Mobile Enhancements Tests (cart, checkout, tracking, dashboard)
nodes.norm_label: customer mobile enhancements tests (cart, checkout, tracking, dashboard)

nodes.label: Phone-Only Customer Login
nodes.rationale: Customer users must log in by phone number only; app_user.email made nullable; inactive/unapproved accounts are blocked.

nodes.label: CustomerDashboardController (period stats, top products, branch comparison)
nodes.norm_label: customerdashboardcontroller (period stats, top products, branch comparison)

nodes.label: API v1 Route Prefix Migration
nodes.rationale: All routes wrapped under /api/v1; frontend clients, Swagger server URL, tests and docs updated to match.

nodes.label: Vite API Proxy Target Fix (http://web -> http://localhost / http://nginx)
nodes.rationale: The previous proxy target http://web did not exist; local dev now uses http://localhost and Docker uses http://nginx.
nodes.norm_label: vite api proxy target fix (http://web -> http://localhost / http://nginx)

nodes.label: Skeleton Loading Components
nodes.rationale: Reusable Skeleton components replace plain loading text in admin and customer frontends.

nodes.label: Combined Frontend Container (admin at /, customer at /customer/)
nodes.rationale: One container serves both frontends: admin at / and customer at /customer/.
nodes.norm_label: combined frontend container (admin at /, customer at /customer/)

nodes.label: React Compiler Not Enabled
nodes.rationale: React Compiler is left off in the template because of its impact on dev and build performance.

nodes.label: POST /api/v1/login (phone or email; 403 for pending customer)
nodes.norm_label: post /api/v1/login (phone or email; 403 for pending customer)

nodes.label: Order Cancellation Request (admin-reviewed)
nodes.rationale: A customer cannot cancel an order itself; it submits a cancellation request that the admin reviews via PUT /api/v1/orders/{id} with status cancelled. Already-processed orders return 422.

nodes.label: Two-Step Customer Onboarding (register user, then add customer pending approval)
nodes.rationale: Registration creates only the user; after login the app checks /customer/profile, then POSTs the customer record which stays pending until an admin approves it.
nodes.norm_label: two-step customer onboarding (register user, then add customer pending approval)

nodes.label: Mermaid Diagrams in Swagger UI Workaround
nodes.rationale: Swagger UI does not render Mermaid; to keep diagrams near the API, paste the Mermaid block into an operation's @OA description where it shows as a code block.
nodes.norm_label: mermaid diagrams in swagger ui workaround
